title: Sailing CBI (Cape Breton Island) Inc.
specs: Sailing on Bras d'Or Lake, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve
Luxury 42' Alpha catamaran with two Queen suites and three-quarter berth
Scenic views including bald eagle nests, Kidston Island lighthouse, and Alexander Graham Bell's summer home
Children must be supervised and wear life jackets on foredeck
Pets not permitted on charters or cottage
Valid Nova Scotia Fishing License required to fish
Passport required for travelers from outside Canada
Proof of collateral insurance required for bareboat charters
Charters priced for up to 6 guests; additional guests $75 each
Maximum occupancy 4 adults for cottage rental
includes: All necessary navigational, safety, and housekeeping supplies
Two full bathrooms with showers, fresh linens and towels
Fully equipped galley with refrigerators, freezer, stove, storage
Life jackets/PFDs and first aid kit
blurb: Guests sail on a luxury 42' Alpha catamaran on Bras d'Or Lake, enjoying scenic views, swimming, paddle boarding, and local flavors. Charters range from 2-hour evening to 6-hour daytime trips, with options for overnight stays. A 2-bedroom vacation cottage rental is also available near Baddeck for island adventures.
extraNote: Full payment due 15 days prior to charter date · Refunds at discretion for unsafe weather; full deposit refundable 30 days prior · Alternate date possible for extreme weather or mechanical problems · Cleaning charge $125 per cottage stay · Baddeck Community Wharf, behind Freight Shed Waterside Bistro · Nova Scotia's warmest months of the year
